facts: Leak on copper supply line to the toilet discovered in the upstairs bathroom.
Subfloor rotted and mold growth on joists due to water exposure.
Plumber's opinion that the leak had been ongoing for roughly six to eight weeks before discovery.
note: The loss resulted from water that seeped continuously for more than 14 days, which matches the definition of "continuous seepage" in Clause 1(d) and triggers the E-18 exclusion for all Section I coverages. The exclusion applies regardless of any other provisions. [HO-0304_03-24#02] [HO-0304_03-24#05]
